key_insight: Conformal-DRO builds a finite-sample ambiguity set for latent future distributions using nested conformal regions, giving a distributionally robust guarantee without estimating the hidden law or its mixing process.
engineering_relevance: This offers a practical way to make decisions under hidden heterogeneity with a certified worst-case expected cost, useful for safety-critical and uncertainty-aware optimization pipelines.
method: Use nested conformal sets to define “conformal shells” around latent outcomes.
Form an ambiguity set over the future latent law with radius controlled by α.
Solve the robust objective as a finite linear program with sparse adversarial solutions.
evidence_signal: Under exchangeability, the ambiguity set covers the latent future law with probability at least 1−α in finite samples, yielding a certificate for the selected decision’s expected cost.
watch_item: The guarantee relies on exchangeability and on the conformal construction; violations of these assumptions or poor finite-sample calibration can weaken the robustness certificate.
paper_title: Conformal-DRO: Distributionally Robust Optimization with Conformalized Ambiguity Set
